best_idea: When an action chain is cut, its not-yet-started effects still run if they are marked forced and are dropped otherwise, and a prioritised chain cannot be cut at all, so an effect the rules already decided (a hit) lands even when the animation that carries it is cancelled.
decision_why: Take the rules (forced effect = ledger effect, unforced = cosmetic, prioritised = not cuttable) with the server's ledger effects as the forced set; the licence is restricted so only the shape is recorded, and the forced-at-cut timing (a hit can land early) must be chosen explicitly.
acceptance: A server test: a hit-reaction chain with a forced hit effect at step 2 still applies the hit when a new order cuts the chain at step 1; an unforced dust effect after the cut does not run; a prioritised chain refuses the cut and plays to its end.
